title: Sodium Extra
description: A Sodium addon that adds features that shouldn't be in Sodium.
author: FlashyReese

license.name: GNU Lesser General Public License v3.0 only

body:
# What is Sodium Extra?
Sodium Extra aims to bring most of OptiFine's eye-candy options to Sodium; in addition to providing some features such as visual bug fixes and other performance options that are not yet available on Sodium.

# Features
Here is a basic rundown of what this mod does.

- Animations Settings (Control fire, water, lava, block animations and etc...)
- Particles Settings (Control all types of particles, including ones from other mods)
- Details Settings (Control sky, stars, sun/moon, weather, and much more)
- Render Settings (Control fog, static entities, and other miscellaneous renderings)
- Extra Settings (Display FPS, coordinates, toast notifications, clouds, and much more)

See a more detailed explanation of what features are included in Sodium Extra [here](https://github.com/FlashyReese/sodium-extra-fabric/wiki/Features).

# Modpack Permissions
This is a free and open-source project; you can include it in your mod pack as long as you provide attribution!

# Common Questions
- **Do I need Sodium installed for this mod to work?** You will need to download Sodium for this mod to work.
- **Can I re-host/upload this mod somewhere else?** Yes, as long as you provide the mod source code. Preferably if you message/ask me for permission about it first.
- **Will you add x features to this mod?** No, unless I explicitly state that I will.
- **I have more questions!** Join our [Discord](https://flashyreese.me/discord)!

# Support the project
[![Support me Ko-fi](https://i.imgur.com/FSNi7zk.png)](https://ko-fi.com/flashyreese)

versions.name: [Fabric] Sodium Extra 0.9.4 - Minecraft 26.3
versions.changelog:
### Changed

- Ported Sodium Extra to Minecraft 26.3.
- Reworked Reduce Resolution on macOS to use SDL's high pixel-density window handling.
- Improved planar and custom fog distance handling.

### Removed

- Removed the Wayland/XWayland Fullscreen Resolution option and recovery flow; Sodium now provides this support.
- Removed the legacy macOS OpenGL and Vulkan framebuffer/presentation workarounds; SDL now handles the required window scaling.

### Fixed

- Fixed Panini Projection scaling with the active FOV.
- Fixed blank tooltip translations.
- Fixed custom fog distance encoding and preservation.
- Improved fog rendering compatibility by avoiding a Redirect.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/FlashyReese/sodium-extra/compare/mc26.2-0.9.4...mc26.3-0.9.4
